mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM STUDENT_DETAIL S JOIN MEMBER M USING(USER_NO) WHERE M.ROLE_CODE = 'STUDENT' AND M.STATUS IN('ACTIVE', 'INACTIVE') AND S.STUDENT_STATUS IN ('ABSENT', 'ATTENDING')

SELECT SM.USER_NAME AS studentName , NVL2(SM.PHONE, SUBSTR(SM.PHONE, 1, 3) || '-' || SUBSTR(SM.PHONE, 4, 4) || '-' || SUBSTR(SM.PHONE, 8, 4), '미등록') AS phone , NVL(CM.USER_NAME, '미배정') AS counselorName , S.CREATED_AT AS createdAt , S.STUDENT_STATUS AS studentStatus , S.STUDENT_NO AS studentNo FROM STUDENT_DETAIL S JOIN MEMBER SM ON (SM.USER_NO = S.USER_NO) LEFT JOIN COUNSELOR_PROFILE C ON(S.COUNSELOR_NO = C.COUNSEL_NO) LEFT JOIN MEMBER CM ON (CM.USER_NO = C.USER_NO) WHERE SM.ROLE_CODE = 'STUDENT' AND SM.STATUS IN('ACTIVE', 'INACTIVE') AND S.STUDENT_STATUS IN ('ABSENT', 'ATTENDING') ORDER BY STUDENT_NO DESC

SELECT S.STUDENT_NO AS studentNo , SM.USER_NO AS userNo , SM.USER_NAME AS studentName , NVL2(SM.PHONE, SUBSTR(SM.PHONE, 1, 3) || '-' || SUBSTR(SM.PHONE, 4, 4) || '-' || SUBSTR(SM.PHONE, 8, 4), '미등록') AS phone , SM.EMAIL AS email , SM.CREATED_AT AS createdAt , CLASS_NAME AS className , NVL(CM.USER_NAME, '미배정') AS counselorName , S.STUDENT_STATUS AS studentStatus , S.UPDATED_AT AS updatedAt FROM STUDENT_DETAIL S JOIN MEMBER SM ON (S.USER_NO = SM.USER_NO) JOIN CLASS CL ON (SM.CLASS_NO = CL.CLASS_NO) LEFT JOIN COUNSELOR_PROFILE C ON(S.COUNSELOR_NO = C.COUNSEL_NO) LEFT JOIN MEMBER CM ON (CM.USER_NO = C.USER_NO) WHERE S.STUDENT_NO = #{studentNo}
